name: Tirolini Cucina & Bar
kurzbeschreibung: **Tirolini Cucina & Bar in Telfs** – A cozy spot in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic **Tiroler** flavors meet modern twists. Savor classic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, or fresh **Käseknödel**, paired with local craft beers and fine wines. Whether you're craving a quick snack or a full meal, this charming bar and kitchen offers a warm, inviting atmosphere—perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes around **Innsbruck** and **Telfs**. Try their signature cocktails or enjoy a relaxed evening with friends over a plate of **Speckknödel** and a cold **Tiroler Bier**. A must-visit for food lovers and travelers alike!
